title: The News of Death Spreads Across the World
next_chapter_hook: However, when Chen Ji turned the pages of the scorched relic, a line of blurred characters made his pupils constrict—it was Chen Nian's handwriting, and the letter contained a secret he had never told anyone.

text.content: The candles in the Imperial Medical Bureau flickered unstably, the air thick with the heavy scent of medicine and the aura of death. The trembling hand of the Chief Imperial Physician finally stopped the brush, and the line 'Life force severed, beyond redemption' seemed to pronounce the end of everything. Yet, at this critical moment, the fingertips beneath the white cloth twitched slightly. Had anyone lifted the cloth at this instant, they would have seen the pale face bearing an almost imperceptible curve at the corner of the lips—a composure of a finished chess game, not the end of death. Chen Ji, this servant disciple who walked the world bearing the name 'trash,' was using the world as his chessboard, performing an unprecedented deception of 'deceiving heaven.'

The Imperial Palace, Daming Hall. The Crown Prince's face was so gloomy that it seemed to drip water; memorials scattered at his feet bore the news of Chen Ji's 'sudden death' in every character. This worthless servant, once the most crucial piece in his game at the Tianqing Sect, had now become the news of his lost right-hand man. 'Trash?' The Crown Prince sneered, the laughter hiding an undeniable anxiety, 'If he truly were trash, why would I have exhausted myself trying to recruit him? Someone who could force Ling Yuan back three steps is no ordinary creature!' He rose abruptly, his eyes flashing, 'Summon the order—I will personally go to the Tianqing Sect to offer condolences!' The vacuum of power is more terrifying than death itself.

dialogue.content: Beyond the Mountain Gate of the Tianqing Sect, in a secluded cave, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The wound on his chest had nearly healed—that illusion of 'life force severed' was precisely the camouflage ability granted by the Tianji Record Fragment. He sat cross-legged, his divine sense spreading like silk, perceiving all movements within and beyond the sect. A slight smile curved his lips, cold and composed: 'The Crown Prince's reaction is even more urgent than I anticipated.' He murmured to himself, tapping his brow center lightly, 'Then, how will the others react?'

text.content: Xuanwu Sect, Heavenly Secrets Peak. In the sect master's study, Han Lie stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the sea of clouds beyond the window. When the news of 'Chen Ji's death' arrived, he froze for a full three breaths, then burst into roaring laughter, the sound shaking the roof tiles. 'Dead? Hah, truly dead!' He laughed until tears nearly formed, yet in the next instant, he abruptly ceased, a subtle undercurrent of gloom flickering in his eyes, 'That trash died just like that?' He clenched his fists, knuckles whitening, an inexplicable不甘 surging in his heart—he had yet to personally defeat that man, this victory had come too easily, too boringly.

dialogue.content: Tianqing Sect, Rear Mountain Forbidden Grounds. Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his white hair fluttering violently in the wind. His disciple hastily reported the news of Chen Ji's 'sudden death.' Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan remained silent for a long while, a fleeting gleam of sharp light flickering in his clouded old eyes. 'Dead?' His voice was flat, revealing neither joy nor anger, 'What a pity.' Before his words even finished, he turned to gaze toward the depths of the forbidden grounds, where an ancient and dangerous aura faintly emanated. A meaningful smile curved his lips, 'But how could things be so convenient in this world? How could Chen Xuan's inheritor fall so easily?' He waved his hand, 'Continue watching. If there is any unusual movement, report immediately.'

text.content: At the same time, in the thousand-year sealed stone chamber deep within the forbidden grounds, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled slightly. He floated in the void, his form so ethereal it seemed ready to dissipate at any moment, yet in those profound eyes, a glimmer of understanding flickered. 'The disguise technique of the Tianji Record?' He murmured to himself, a sense of relief surfacing in his turbid eyes, 'This child is more adept at patience than I anticipated.' His gaze pierced through layers of stone walls, as if he could see Chen Ji sitting cross-legged in the cave dwelling, 'But the true trial is just beginning. That old fox Ling Yuan is not so easily fooled...'

Outside the Mountain Gate of the Tianqing Sect, a chaotic hubbub filled the air. Visitors coming to 'offer condolences' were endless, not a few being scouts from various factions. At this moment, a sinister black mist rolled across the horizon, its demonic aura causing everyone present to change color. 'The Demonic Path! It's someone from the Demonic Path!' Exclamations erupted, and the guests scrambled backward. Yet, the black mist condensed into a graceful figure before the mountain gate—the Holy Sect Saint, Ye Qing. Dressed in plain white robes, her face bore fitting sorrow, as if she were truly a friend come to mourn. 'Hearing of Young Master Chen's ascension to immortality, I have specially come to see him off.' Her voice was cold and clear, yet her gaze swept across the crowd with purpose, 'I wonder if the Tianqing Sect would be so kind as to grant me passage?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing entered the funeral hall, her plain white skirt trailing elegant arcs across the ground. She gazed upon the 'Chen Ji's' remains in the coffin, yet deep in her eyes, a subtle gleam of insight flickered. She stepped forward to offer three sticks of incense, her movements respectful and sincere, yet in the moment she bent down, her lips nearly touched the 'remains'' ear, whispering in a voice only the two could hear: 'Your acting is quite convincing.' Before her words even faded, she had straightened up, her expression still that of a compassionate saint, 'Young Master Chen, may you journey well.' She turned and departed, her steps composed, yet the instant she crossed the threshold of the funeral hall, the corners of her lips curved slightly—the chess game has begun, let's see what waves this 'trash' can still make.

text.content: Outside the funeral hall, Ye Qing was stopped by Tianqing Sect disciples. 'Your Highness Saint, our sect is sworn enemies of the Holy Sect—you boldly walking through our mountain gate, aren't you taking us far too lightly!' The leading disciple shouted in fury, sword already drawn. Ye Qing neither grew angry nor upset, merely gently raising her hand, a pitch-black lotus blooming in her palm, 'I came to mourn an old friend, unrelated to sect disputes.' She surveyed her surroundings, her gaze cold and sharp, 'What, does the Tianqing Sect lack such magnanimity? Could it be...' She shifted her words, a derisive curve forming her lips, 'You fear I might discover some flaw?' At these words, the expressions of those present varied; many secretly speculated—just what is the relationship between this Demonic Path Saint and that trash Chen Ji?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's appearance has already caused an uproar; Chen Ji must decide how to deal with this 'unexpected' event. His choice will affect the direction of the subsequent situation.

choices.text: Secretly transmit voice, warn Ye Qing to restrain herself
choices.description: Through the hidden connection of the Tianji Record Fragment, transmit a warning to Ye Qing, reminding her not to appear too familiar, so as not to arouse Ling Yuan's suspicion.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the integrity of the disguise, reduce the risk of exposure
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's personality is stubborn; she may not heed the warning

text.content: Chen Ji's brow creased slightly, his fingertips quietly gathering spiritual power, a barely perceptible thread of divine sense passing through countless barriers, reaching the depths of Ye Qing's consciousness: 'Your Highness Saint, please conduct yourself with dignity. There should be no such familiarity between us.' The voice was cold, carrying an unquestionable warning. Ye Qing's steps paused subtly, her expression unchanged, yet in the depths of her eyes, a playful gleam flickered—This man is indeed as cautious as ever.

choices.text: Do nothing, quietly observe the changes
choices.description: Trust Ye Qing's judgment, let her continue to act freely. After all, her identity as the Holy Sect Saint is itself the best cover.
choices.visible_reward: Observe the reactions of all parties, gather intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's actions may exceed expectations, bringing variables

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the urge to act, deciding to trust Ye Qing's discretion. He quietly withdrew his divine sense, continuing to observe all movements inside and outside the funeral hall from a bystander's perspective. 'Since this woman dares to come, she must have something to rely on.' He thought secretly, 'Let's see what tricks she can pull.' However, Ye Qing's next words made his pupils constrict—this woman's nerve is truly too great.

After Ye Qing's departure, the funeral hall restored its superficial tranquility. Yet, rumors of her 'old acquaintance' with Chen Ji spread like wildfire among the crowd. 'Did you hear? The Demonic Path Saint actually has history with Chen Ji!' 'Not just history—I personally saw her whispering before the coffin, so intimate, clearly...' 'Shh! Quiet! If such a scandal spreads, the Tianqing Sect's face will be utterly lost!' Gossip spread like venomous snakes everywhere, making Chen Ji's 'death,' which should have been straightforward, increasingly shrouded in mystery. And those factions with ulterior motives also caught a different scent in these rumors—perhaps Chen Ji's death was not that simple after all.

"Tianqing Town, Drunken Immortal Pavilion. A gathering place for people from all walks of life, yet today's topic is surprisingly unified—thetrash少爷 of the Chen family is dead. 'Have you heard? That servant disciple Chen Ji from the Tianqing Sect has died suddenly!' A drunkard slammed the table and shouted, 'What's that about ranking first in the inner sect assessment? What's that about defeating the Xuanwu prodigy? All lies! Look, even Heaven couldn't stand it!' The crowd burst into laughter—some agreeing, others shaking their heads. A filthy little beggar squeezed forward, his eyes gleaming with cunning: 'Sir, you say Chen Ji istrash? Do you know what was the last thing he did before he died?' The drunkard froze. 'What?' The little beggar grinned, revealing a few broken teeth: 'He donated all his savings to the orphanage in town. A full three thousand taels of silver!' At these words, everyone was shocked."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji observed the public discussions from the shadows, discovering that some deliberately smeared him while others defended him. He needed to decide his next move."

choices.description: Have subordinates spread the word: claiming that Chen Ji left behind a legacy before his death, containing earth-shattering secrets. This move will draw the attention of various forces while laying the groundwork for the real clues."
choices.visible_reward: Lure out the snake, expose hidden enemies",
choices.risk_hint: May attract greedy scoundrels coveting the legacy",

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and a bold plan took shape in his mind. He quietly contacted several undercover agents spreading rumors, instructing in a low voice: 'Spread the word—say that this one left behind a legacy before death, containing secrets that could change the world's landscape.' The agents departed with their orders, and a faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. 'Since they all want to see what this one left behind, let's let them see enough.' He wanted to see which fox would show its tail first when all manner of demons gathered."

choices.text: "Personally appear in person, shatter the rumors",
choices.description: Abort the fake death plan and 'revive' publicly at the Chen Family Ancestral Hall, breaking all doubts in the most shocking way possible. This move carries extremely high risk, but the rewards are equally staggering."
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may seize this opportunity to launch a fatal strike",

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, light blazing within them. He rose decisively, stretching his stiff limbs. 'Since they want to see a dead man return to life, this one shall satisfy them.' His voice was cold and resolute. 'In three days, at the Chen Family Ancestral Hall, this one will let the world witness what it means to rise from the dead!' The words fell, and he strode out of the cave. The setting sun's lingering glow fell upon him, stretching that silhouette long and proud—the era belonging to him was only just beginning."

"Tianqing Sect, Main Peak. Su Qingyao stood alone atop the cliff's edge, cold wind stirring her waterfall-like hair, yet unable to disperse the heaviness between her brows. As Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she should have remained indifferent to Chen Ji's 'death'—after all, he was merely atrash servant, irrelevant to her. However, upon hearing the news that Ye Qing had come to 'mourn,' an inexplicable irritability surged in her heart. 'That woman, what is her relationship with him?' she murmured, her gaze flickering. 'Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, how many secrets are you still hiding?' She closed her eyes, and those three memories of infinitely approaching the truth rushed in like a tide, only to be forcibly suppressed. 'Forget it,' she sighed softly. 'If you truly can return from death, then I, Su Qingyao, must get clear answers myself.'"

dialogue.content: "Deep into the night, Chen Ji quietly returned to the Chen Family Old Residence. This dilapidated mansion was a symbol of his 'trash少爷' identity, and also his final retreat. However, when he pushed open that mottled wooden door, he found everything inside unchanged, as if the master had never left. On the table sat a pot of cold tea, beside which was a letter with singed corners. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was Chen Nian's handwriting! His fingertips trembled as he picked up the letter, and by the faint moonlight, several blurred characters could be discerned: 'Brother... Forbidden Grounds... Heavenly Fate...' He abruptly raised his head, eyes blazing. 'Nian Nian, where exactly are you?'"

text.content: "Just as Chen Ji was completely absorbed in the letter, a ghostly figure silently appeared behind him. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul phantom manifested, his turbid eyes flickering with complex light. 'This letter was left by Chen Nian before she was taken away.' His voice was ethereal and distant. 'She foresaw something, which is why she left this letter. Only...' He paused, his gaze profound, 'any prophecy involving her is blurred. The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock and Key cannot be fully glimpsed even by the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji spun around, staring intently at the phantom. 'Tell me, where is Nian Nian exactly?' Mo Xiansheng merely shook his head. 'The time is not yet right. What you must do now is survive, grow stronger, and then... find her.'"

choice.prompt: "Mo Xiansheng's appearance made Chen Ji realize that clues about his sister Chen Nian had surfaced. He must make a choice: purely pursue investigation into Chen Nian's whereabouts, or continue to endure and lay plans in silence?"

choices.description: Chen Nian is his only relative and also his greatest weakness. No matter how much Mo Xiansheng was willing to reveal, he would pursue the truth to the end."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about Chen Nian",
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Mo Xiansheng, lose guidance",

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward abruptly, both fists clenched tightly. 'Master, my sister was taken by the Holy Sect, her life uncertain—how can I sit by and do nothing?' His voice carried rare urgency. 'Tell me, where is she? Even through mountains of blades and seas of fire, I must bring her back!' Mo Xiansheng gazed at the young man before him, a glimmer of approval appearing in his turbid eyes. 'You truly cannot let go of her.' He sighed softly. 'Very well, given your sincere heart, I shall tell you one location—in the extreme cold lands of the Northern Domain, there exists an ancient ruin called the 'Heavenly Fate Altar.' Your sister is there.'"

choices.description: Chen Nian's lead is indeed important, but he is still too weak right now. Acting rashly would only harm his sister. It would be better to take advantage of this feigned death and quietly accumulate strength.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily suspend the plan to search for relatives
choices.visible_reward: Obtain new knowledge of the Tianji Record imparted by Mo Xiansheng
choices.risk_hint: Inner guilt, which may affect one's Dao heart

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the anxiety in his heart. He slowly unclenched his fists, and the sharp light in his eyes gradually receded. "Master, you are right. Nian Nian is my weakness—if I act rashly now, the enemy will use her to threaten me." He raised his head, his gaze firm and cold. "I want to become stronger, strong enough that no one can stand against me, strong enough to protect everyone I wish to protect!" Mo Xiansheng nodded with satisfaction. "The student shows promise. Since you've come to understand this, I shall impart to you another page of the Tianji Record—the true secret of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock.'"

Meanwhile, deep within the Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan knelt alone before an ancient altar, his turbid eyes flickering with an eerie glow. "Chen Ji is dead?" His voice was hoarse and icy cold. "No, he is not dead. This old man can sense the presence of the Tianji Record." He abruptly raised his head, his gaze seemingly piercing through layers of stone walls. "However, this is an excellent opportunity." He drew from his bosom a pitch-black令牌 inscribed with ancient and sinister runes. "Since that boy wants to play the game of feigned death, this old man shall ride the current and send him a grand gift." A cruel smile curved his lips. "During the Sect Competition three days later, let the entire world see whose world the Tianqing Sect truly belongs to!"

The world's landscape surged with turmoil due to the "death of Chen Ji." The Crown Prince of the Imperial Dynasty lost his right-hand man and grew restless; the three major sects harbored ulterior motives, engaging in covert power plays; the Saintess of the Demonic Path unexpectedly appeared, exposing her clandestine relationship with Chen Ji; and among the common folk, rumors about the "trash young master" spread like wildfire. Yet beneath this seemingly chaotic surface, an invisible hand was quietly manipulating the gears of fate. Chen Ji, this servant disciple walking the world under the name of "trash," was using the world as his chessboard, executing an unprecedented spectacular game. Three days later, the Sect Competition; the Heavenly Fate artifact, its mystery yet to be revealed. And his sister, missing for many years, awaited him in the depths of the mist. The chess game of fate has been laid out—and he is the one holding the pieces.

However, when Chen Ji opened that遗物 scorched by flames, a line of blurred writing made his pupils contract—it was Chen Nian's handwriting, and the letter contained a secret he had never told anyone. On the letter, Chen Nian's elegant characters read: "Brother, I know your secret. The Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng, and... your true identity. If you're reading this letter, it means I'm no longer here. But don't worry—I will be waiting for you at 'that place.' Remember, Northern Region, Heavenly Fate Altar, third level—the answers you seek are all there." Chen Ji's hand trembled violently, his eyes flickering with stormy waves—his true identity? What did Chen Nian know? What earth-shattering truth was hidden in "that place" she mentioned?
